column1: # Function-size ratchet baseline (refactor wave 1, W5). Enforced by
# One row per function over 300 lines in src/**/*.ts (excluding *.generated.ts),
# keyed by path + name path (never line numbers). Rows only shrink: lower a row
# when its function shrinks, remove it when the function drops to 300 lines or
# fewer. Raising a row or adding one needs an issue/TODO id in the justification.
